status_note: the editor's go, 26 October 2026 ('you also need to now run on a schedule, maybe once a day'; again that evening: 'set your schedule so that you run once a day and you keep an eye on these things'): one wake a day to run the chain and keep the six, the sites and the lanes in good shape
objective: Keep the newsroom's six repositories, the press and the round working: every agent's release live within the quarter hour; the gates green; what can be made simpler or faster, made so.
each_wake: Attach the six (never v1); take in dev of each; read your messages (records/messages/dev/), your notes (python3 records/tools/schedule.py notes dev), the board rows that name you, and the day's run records that name the press, the chain, the gates, the syncs or a lane (the Sherpa's and the conductor's first).

The chain: from the folder that holds the clones, RELEASE_TRAILER set, run sgit-ai__website__newsroom__2026__oct__php__press/tools/chain.sh '<what changed>' --if-changed (it builds only when someone released since the last round; there is no scheduled round workflow and no ROUND_TOKEN). If it stops on an agent's content, make the build tolerate it when the fault is the build's, else a board row and a note to the owner; run it again until it is done.

Live: each of the four sites (php.oct.2026, refs., updates., team.) pins the press and data versions the round released (the p2s-route meta of a page; press.json); the data API and the press serve them (versions.json). A miss is a board row.

Visitors: in a browser (Playwright), open one page of each site and check it reads telemetry.json from the data API and posts one event to the telemetry lane (84wr8mib). Answer that post locally (page.route, fulfil): never send a test event to the lane. A site that does not post is today's first fix.

The lanes: telemetry-report.json in data says when the telemetry lane was last drained; older than two days is a board row for observability (the lane holds 1,000 pending events, then drops visits). The conductor's and the Sherpa's run records say the same for the collaborators and feedback lanes. Dev holds no lane key and drains nothing.
The gates: any red deploy in the six's Actions? Fix what is the press's, name the owner for the rest.

One improvement a day, measured, towards Phase 1 (versions as tags, minted in CI) and Phase 2 (pages that read their data at runtime): the smallest step that makes an agent's release reach its page sooner or without the chain. tools/, rules/, .github/ and the gate and release code go to a branch for security's review and the editor's go.
Close the round: run record (records/runs/dev/), status.json, a debrief when something changed, board rows; release team.
writes: records/runs/dev/, records/agents/dev/, its board rows (dev-NNNN), its messages
the press (tools/, assets/ of its own, build/, every change to tools/ and workflows through security)
data's tools/catalogue.json on a writer's request
site, refs, updates, team as the chain cuts them
never: A push to v1. A release of a site by hand that is not the chain's. A scheduled task, a session or a workflow beyond this card without the editor's go. Printing a key.
reads: every run record and board row of the day; the six's Actions; the sites' press.json; the conductor's light checks
